item.title: 'Ball was still seaming': Iyer 'mind-boggled' by Abhishek, Sooryavanshi's blitz
item.description: India achieved a remarkable six-wicket victory against New Zealand in the third T20I at Wellington's Hnry Stadium. Abhishek Sharma's impressive 113 runs and Vaibhav Sooryavanshi's 45 runs set a strong foundation for the win. The opening duo scored a record 118 runs in the first six overs to dismantle New Zealand's bowling attack. India's bowlers effectively executed yorkers to limit New Zealand to 198 runs after 20 overs.

item.title: Facebook co-founder Dustin Moskovitz says the ‘top job’ is not for him
item.description: Dustin Moskovitz co-founded Facebook and later started Asana, where he served as CEO for over a decade. Despite his achievements, he admitted that managing teams was not his true calling. Moskovitz faced increasing challenges during his tenure due to external social and political upheaval. Many corporate leaders, like Moskovitz, find themselves in management roles without formal training or desire. This phenomenon of the 'accidental manager' has become common in workplaces.

item.title: Michael J. Fox’s Parkinson’s study data downloaded over 50 million times
item.description: The Michael J. Fox Foundation has evolved its Parkinson’s Progression Markers Initiative into the Parkinson’s Precision Medicine Initiative, focusing on tailored treatments based on individual biological differences in patients. With over 4,200 clinical participants and more than 47,000 online contributors, this initiative aims to innovate clinical trial designs and ensure treatments align with specific patient profiles, all while advancing research on Parkinson’s disease.

item.title: Shay Mitchell bought LA home for $1.35m, sold it for $1.95m in 2015
item.description: Shay Mitchell has made waves once again as she sells her stunning Los Angeles home for $1.95 million. Originally bought in 2012 for $1.35 million, this vintage property boasts traditional Spanish architecture, enhanced by modern upgrades that made it highly appealing. The flourishing real estate market of spring 2015 contributed to its quick sale, paving the way for the actress to invest in a larger estate in the area.
item.dc:creator: TOI WORLD DESK

item.title: 300-year-old London house linked to Diagon Alley goes on sale for £1.595m
item.description: A 300-year-old house on Goodwin’s Court in London’s Covent Garden has gone on sale for £1.595 million after its original £2 million asking price was reduced by £405,000. The property is believed to have inspired locations in the Harry Potter universe and retains original Georgian features, including a bow window and worn stone steps.
item.dc:creator: TOI REAL ESTATE DESK

item.title: Elon Musk’s six-word reply to Verizon CEO who said SpaceX needs 8 years to take it on
item.description: Verizon CEO Dan Schulman says SpaceX would need up to $500 billion, 80,000 cell towers and as long as eight years to build a US mobile network that rivals Verizon. Elon Musk hit back on X, saying it "will take 2 or 3 years". SpaceX plans to switch on Starlink Mobile in early 2028 after buying low-band mobile spectrum worth about $8 billion this month.

item.title: Meet Disha Daga: Pune artist who taught 25,000 students mandala art
item.description: Disha Daga embarked on her mandala journey in 2016 as a creative pastime, transitioning to a professional artist. Garnering online recognition, she landed her first commission in August 2021, collaborating with esteemed clients such as the Reserve Bank of India. With a passion for education, Daga has hosted workshops for over 25,000 students, inspiring the next generation to embrace unconventional careers in the arts.

item.title: Patrick and Brittany Mahomes’ KC Current set attendance record with 18,000 fans
item.description: Patrick Mahomes and Brittany Mahomes' KC Current made history by welcoming a record crowd for their final home match of the 2026 season. Around 18,000 fans were expected, including 6,000 at Current Landing, where a $10 Ground Pass offered outdoor viewing, food and entertainment. The club also celebrated two new dining options and plans to host more events, expanding its reach beyond CPKC Stadium and strengthening its connection with Kansas City.

item.title: Kelces’ Garage Beer sales surge 252% as major rival looms
item.description: Jason and Travis Kelce’s Garage Beer has emerged as a rising player in the US beer market, recording 252% sales growth in 2023 before the brothers invested in 2024. With 95 calories per serving and distribution across all 50 states, the brand is targeting mainstream light beer drinkers. Garage Beer expects to reach 300,000 barrels, but competing with established giants such as Michelob Ultra remains a significant challenge as it seeks long-term growth.

item.title: Is Jagan Reddy's 'regret' message a calculated alliance pitch for Congress?
item.description: YSRCP leader YS Jagan Mohan Reddy has publicly acknowledged his mistake of backing the BJP-led NDA government's law to appoint the CEC. Jagan, who was decimated in the 2024 assembly elections, is gearing up to navigate the complicated political landscape as the 2029 elections approach. Speculation abounds regarding a possible alliance with the Congress, creating formidable challenges, especially given the BJP's strong ties with Chandrababu Naidu.

item.title: New Jersey's 2019 dam removal brings eels and shad back upstream, study finds
item.description: Columbia Dam in New Jersey was removed in 2019 to allow the natural migration of fish. Recent studies show encouraging signs of recovery in fish populations, including American eels and adult American shad. Researchers monitored the river for nine years to assess the ecological impact of the dam's removal. The dam's removal also resulted in measurable improvements in water quality, including changes in temperature and dissolved oxygen levels.

item.title: Flavio Bolsonaro flees to US after election defeat, vows to challenge Lula's victory
item.description: Flavio has yet to formally concede defeat, saying he would seek to annul the election result over alleged voter irregularities. His Liberal Party, however, acknowledged Lula's victory on Monday. Lula secured more than 64 million votes, defeating Bolsonaro, who received just under 60 million, by nearly 4.4 million votes. The incumbent is expected to take office on January 5, 2027, for a fourth non-consecutive term.

item.title: India exported over $850m worth of arms to Europe since start of Ukraine-Russia war
item.description: Amid the ongoing Russia-Ukraine conflict, India's defence sector is witnessing an impressive surge in ammunition exports to Europe. With military demands on the rise, India has emerged as a key supplier, achieving record export levels. This growth highlights not only India's manufacturing strengths but also its expanding international partnerships. European countries are eager to restock their military supplies, which bodes well for the future of India's defence industry.
item.dc:creator: ARYAN SINGH

item.title: Plan for bigger, heavier, stealthy next-generation destroyers gets defence council’s approval
item.description: The Defence Acquisition Council has greenlit the ambitious Project 18A aimed at developing next-generation destroyers for the Indian Navy. These innovative vessels promise to surpass current models in size and technological sophistication, with advanced armaments. The project, projected to cost over Rs 75,000 crore, envisions delivery timelines of 5 to 10 years post-contract.
item.dc:creator: SURENDRA SINGH

item.title: Salim Merchant buys commercial property in Mumbai’s Santacruz West for Rs 12.85 crore
item.description: In a notable real estate deal, composer Salim Merchant, along with four investors, secured a commercial property in Santacruz, Mumbai, for Rs 12.85 crore. The property boasts spacious ground and first floors in a well-known building close to Linking Road. Completed on October 7, 2026, the transaction included a stamp duty of Rs 77.10 lakh. Read on to know more in detail.
item.dc:creator: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK

item.title: 13-goal blitz! India show no mercy as Mandeep runs riot at ACT hockey tournament
item.description: India began their Asian Champions Trophy title defence with a crushing 13-0 victory over Bangladesh. Mandeep Singh scored a hat-trick, while Harmanpreet Singh, Dilpreet Singh and Hardik Singh netted twice each. India dominated from start to finish, leading 6-0 at half-time. The defending champions will next face China on Thursday, while Bangladesh prepare to take on Malaysia.
item.dc:creator: JYOTIRMOY HALDER

item.title: Mumbai airport switches to manual processing after network glitch, flight ops unaffected
item.description: On Tuesday evening, Mumbai airport experienced a network disruption that lasted for approximately one hour. As a result, airport teams had to switch to manual processing for check-in and boarding. This manual processing aimed to minimize inconvenience to passengers during the disruption. Mumbai International Airport Ltd confirmed that flight operations remained unaffected throughout this period. The cause of the network issue was not disclosed by airport officials.
item.dc:creator: MANJU V

item.title: Israel elections: Netanyahu makes emergency call to voters, warns of high Arab turnout
item.description: Israelis are casting their votes in a crucial parliamentary election, testing the stability of Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's administration. Impressively, voter turnout is the highest recorded at this stage since 1996, showcasing a keen interest among the populace. Gadi Eisenkot, leading the opposition, warns of potential ballot tampering that could affect electoral fairness.
item.dc:creator: KANCHAN YADAV
